title: Common identifiers
$comment: Content ids follow the format already used in the curriculum data (Faryal's format). Ids never carry a version: versions live in card_version. Never reuse or renumber an id once data references it.

ConceptId.description: One lesson's concept card: <subject>_g<grade>_m<module>_l<lesson>_<short_name>, e.g. math_g1_m1_l1_embedded_numbers

AssessmentCardId.description: A lesson's assessment card: assess_<concept_id>, e.g. assess_math_g1_m1_l1_embedded_numbers (no version suffix)

CardVersion.description: Version of a concept or assessment card. Events record the exact version a child saw.
